scenario.status: Legacy illustrative hypotheses only; 90 mm is not a measured grip, and listed lengths are bare tube lengths, not the preferred overall prototype length.
scenario.assumption_basis: Earlier side-chat arithmetic inputs. The ambiguous80–100mm keys/grip wording was later corrected to a roughly100mm key lower edge, not a grip pivot. Retain these numerical axes only as hypothetical comparisons.
scenario.placement: Tube occupies Y=0..length; tip package is a point at Y=length; near-grip package is a point exactly at the grip pivot. All centres have X=Z=0.
scenario.comparison: Retain the same packages and grip distance from the butt at each length. Compare transverse X inertia and signed gravitational torque with the wand horizontal.
scenario.limits: Range is an envelope over the listed assumed endpoints, not a confidence interval. Near-grip package extent and human grip/arm dynamics omitted. No optimal length claim.
scenario.range_input_scope: Hypothetical axes and tip masses, not bounds on the current hand pivot or a confidence interval.
